name: Nightly Sumeragi Soak

# Sumeragi soak (specs/sumeragi.md §13.5 and §14 item 5, specs/sumeragi_goals.md S7): a real
# multi-process network under P2P loss with delay spikes (tc netem in the soak's own network
# namespace), random kill -9 and restart, and disk-full injection, judged by O-AGR, O-SIGN,
# O-LIVE and O-PERF computed from the node logs (scripts/sumeragi_soak.py); and the P2P lane soak
# (integration_tests/tests/sumeragi_lanes_soak.rs), analyzed with the same oracles.
#
# Nightly: a smoke-length soak at n = 4 and a 20-minute lane soak. Manual dispatch with
# `gate: true` runs the 24 h release gate at n = 4 and n = 22 and a 2 h lane soak.
# Operator procedure: specs/runbooks/sumeragi_taira_reset.md. The runner host must provide the
# sch_netem kernel module.

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "10 3 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      gate:
        description: "Run the 24 h release gate (n = 4 and n = 22) instead of the smoke soak"
        type: boolean
        default: false
      seed:
        description: "Fault-plan seed (default: the workflow run id)"
        type: string
        default: ""

concurrency:
  group: nightly-sumeragi-soak
  cancel-in-progress: false

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always
  NORITO_SKIP_BINDINGS_SYNC: "1"

jobs:
  soak:
    name: Soak n=${{ matrix.validators }} (${{ inputs.gate && 'gate 24 h' || 'smoke' }})
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, iroha2]
    container:
      image: hyperledger/iroha2-ci:nightly-2025-05-08
      # The soak creates its own user, network and mount namespaces (tc netem on the loopback
      # P2P ports, a size-limited tmpfs for the disk-full peer).
      options: --privileged
    timeout-minutes: 1800
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        validators: ${{ fromJSON(inputs.gate && '[4, 22]' || '[4]') }}
    env:
      SOAK_PROFILE: ${{ inputs.gate && 'gate' || 'smoke' }}
      SOAK_SEED: ${{ inputs.seed || github.run_id }}
      SOAK_OUT: artifacts/sumeragi-soak/n${{ matrix.validators }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659
        with:
          cache: "false"
          toolchain: 1.93.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@e18b497796c12c097a38f9edb9d0641fb99eee32
        with:
          cache-on-failure: "true"
          shared-key: sumeragi-soak-1.93.1
      - name: Install tc and unshare
        run: |
          if ! command -v tc >/dev/null || ! command -v unshare >/dev/null; then
            apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends iproute2 util-linux
          fi
      - name: Require sch_netem
        run: modprobe sch_netem 2>/dev/null || test -d /sys/module/sch_netem
      - name: Build the node, Kagami and the CLI
        run: >
          cargo build --locked --release
          -p irohad --bin iroha3d -p iroha_kagami --bin kagami -p iroha_cli --bin iroha
      - name: Soak
        run: >
          python3 scripts/sumeragi_soak.py
          --profile "$SOAK_PROFILE"
          --validators ${{ matrix.validators }}
          --faults kill,disk,net
          --net-mode netem
          --seed "$SOAK_SEED"
          --bin-dir target/release
          --out "$SOAK_OUT"
      - name: Upload the verdict and node logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sumeragi-soak-n${{ matrix.validators }}-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: |
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/verdict.json
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/run.json
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/timeline.json
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/load.json
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/harness-error.txt
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/kagami-localnet.log
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/start-scripts.log
            ${{ env.SOAK_OUT }}/logs
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  lane_soak:
    name: P2P lane soak (${{ inputs.gate && '2 h' || '20 min' }})
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, iroha2]
    container:
      image: hyperledger/iroha2-ci:nightly-2025-05-08
    timeout-minutes: 300
    env:
      IROHA_TEST_REQUIRE_NETWORK: "1"
      TEST_NETWORK_BIN_IROHAD: target/release/iroha3d
      TEST_NETWORK_BIN_IROHA: target/release/iroha
      SUMERAGI_LANES_SOAK_SECS: ${{ inputs.gate && '7200' || '1200' }}
      SUMERAGI_LANES_SOAK_OUT: ${{ github.workspace }}/artifacts/sumeragi-lane-soak
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659
        with:
          cache: "false"
          toolchain: 1.93.1
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@e18b497796c12c097a38f9edb9d0641fb99eee32
        with:
          cache-on-failure: "true"
          shared-key: sumeragi-lane-soak-1.93.1
      - name: Build the node and the CLI
        run: cargo build --locked --release -p irohad --bin iroha3d -p iroha_cli --bin iroha
      - name: Lane soak
        run: >
          cargo test --locked -p integration_tests --test sumeragi_lanes
          -- --ignored soak --nocapture
      - name: Oracles over the lane soak's node logs
        # The soak exports its run whether it passed or not; judge a failed run too.
        if: always() && hashFiles('artifacts/sumeragi-lane-soak/run.json') != ''
        run: python3 scripts/sumeragi_soak.py --analyze "$SUMERAGI_LANES_SOAK_OUT"
      - name: Upload the verdict and node logs
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        with:
          name: sumeragi-lane-soak-${{ github.run_id }}
          path: ${{ env.SUMERAGI_LANES_SOAK_OUT }}
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
